metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties in zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol (Batch 5)

checklist.title: Verify fee computation uses ceiling division to protect protocol revenue
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IncentiveLib.getUnwrapFee() function in contracts/IncentiveLib.sol or similar
2. Verify fee calculation uses ceiling division formula: (amount * feeRate + DENOMINATOR - 1) / DENOMINATOR
3. Confirm no floor division is used that would benefit users at protocol expense
4. Check edge cases: zero amount, maximum amount, boundary fee rates
5. Verify fee rate bounds are enforced (e.g., cannot exceed 100%)
6. Confirm fee is applied before underlying transfer calculation

executable_checks.assertion: Fee calculation function exists with ceiling division
Fee rounds up, protecting protocol from dust loss
Edge cases (zero, max, boundary) handled correctly

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE -> Edge EDGE-LM-CALCULATES-FEE. Fee computation protects protocol from value extraction through rounding attacks. Ceiling division ensures protocol always receives at least the correct fee amount.

checklist.title: Verify burn-before-transfer ordering in unwrap to prevent double-spend
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate unwrap() function in LiquidityManager.sol
2. Verify _burn() is called BEFORE safeTransfer() of underlying tokens
3. Check that burn amount equals the full zERC20 amount being unwrapped
4. Confirm no reentrancy can occur between burn and transfer
5. Verify burn cannot fail silently (should revert on insufficient balance)
6. Ensure checks-effects-interactions pattern is followed

executable_checks.command: Review unwrap() control flow: burn must precede transfer
executable_checks.assertion: Line number of _burn() < line number of safeTransfer()
No reentrancy between burn and transfer

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20 -> Edge EDGE-LM-BURNS-ZERC20. Burn-before-transfer is critical for preventing attackers from reusing zERC20 tokens to claim underlying multiple times. EVM sequential execution ensures burn completes before transfer begins.

checklist.title: Verify exact (amount - fee) underlying transfer using SafeERC20
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate underlying transfer in unwrap() function
2. Verify transfer uses SafeERC20.safeTransfer (not raw transfer)
3. Confirm transfer amount = unwrapAmount - calculatedFee exactly
4. Check no intermediate modifications to transfer amount
5. Verify fee is sent to correct protocol address
6. Ensure no truncation or rounding errors in amount calculation

executable_checks.assertion: User receives exact (amount - fee) underlying tokens
Fee is sent to correct protocol address

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING -> Edge EDGE-LM-TRANSFERS-UNDERLYING. Transfer amount must be computed as amount - fee without modification between computation and actual transfer. SafeERC20 ensures transfer reverts on failure.

checklist.title: Verify Unwrapped event emits accurate amounts matching actual transfers
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate Unwrapped event definition and emission
2. Verify event parameters include: user, amount, fee, netAmount
3. Confirm event uses same computed values as actual transfer
4. Check event emission occurs after successful transfer
5. Verify no code paths emit event without completing transfer
6. Ensure event is not emitted on revert paths

executable_checks.assertion: Event amounts match actual transfer amounts

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-UNWRAP-COMPLETE. Event accuracy is essential for off-chain indexing and user experience. Single transaction ensures event data matches transfer data.

checklist.title: Verify clean revert on insufficient liquidity with no state changes
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate liquidity check in unwrap() function
2. Verify check occurs BEFORE burn operation
3. Confirm InsufficientLiquidity error is defined and used
4. Check revert happens cleanly without partial state changes
5. Verify underlying token balance check is accurate
6. Ensure no gas-only attacks possible via failed unwrap

executable_checks.assertion: Unwrap reverts cleanly when liquidity insufficient
No state changes on liquidity failure

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY -> Edge EDGE-UNWRAP-INSUFFICIENT-LIQUIDITY. Liquidity check must occur before burn to prevent tokens being destroyed without underlying delivery. Clean revert ensures user can retry.

checklist.title: Verify state transition only after successful underlying transfer
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify safeTransfer is used (reverts on failure)
2. Confirm no state indicates completion before transfer succeeds
3. Check for fee-on-transfer token handling if applicable
4. Verify transfer to msg.sender (correct recipient)
5. Ensure transfer amount matches expected value
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING -> Edge EDGE-USER-NOW-HAS-UNDERLYING. safeTransfer reverts on failure, ensuring state transition only occurs on successful transfer. EVM atomicity guarantees consistency.

checklist.title: Verify strict value <= 2^248-1 comparison for BN254 field bounds
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate MAX_VALUE constant in zERC20.sol
2. Verify MAX_VALUE = 2^248 - 1 (not 2^248)
3. Confirm comparison uses <= (not <)
4. Check validation occurs in _afterTokenTransfer hook
5. Verify all transfer entry points are covered
6. Ensure mint operations also validate value
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-VALIDATES-VALUE. BN254 field element constraint requires values < 2^248. Off-by-one error could allow invalid values into hash chain, breaking ZK proofs.

checklist.title: Verify ValueTooLarge custom error provides clear failure reason
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate ValueTooLarge error definition
2. Verify error includes relevant parameters (value, maxValue)
3. Confirm error is used consistently across all validation points
4. Check error message is clear for debugging
5. Verify no silent failures on value overflow

executable_checks.assertion: Error is used on value overflow
ValueTooLarge error thrown with correct data

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE -> Edge EDGE-VALUE-TOO-LARGE. Clear error reporting aids debugging and user experience. Custom errors are gas-efficient and informative.

checklist.title: Verify atomic balance updates in transfer (debit and credit together)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify zERC20 inherits from OpenZeppelin ERC20
2. Confirm _transfer() is used (atomic balance update)
3. Check no custom balance manipulation outside _transfer
4. Verify overflow protection (Solidity 0.8+ or SafeMath)
5. Ensure no intermediate state where balances are inconsistent

executable_checks.assertion: Sum of balances equals total supply after transfer
Both sender debit and recipient credit occur

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-BALANCES. OpenZeppelin ERC20._transfer performs atomic balance updates within single storage operation batch. Solidity 0.8+ provides overflow protection.

checklist.title: Verify SHA-256 hash chain computation matches Nova circuit exactly
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate hash chain update in _afterTokenTransfer
2. Verify formula: SHA256(prevHash || to || value)
3. Confirm truncation to 248 bits matches Nova circuit
4. Check endianness and padding are correct
5. Verify hash chain index is updated atomically
6. Compare with Nova circuit implementation

executable_checks.assertion: Hash function used for chain update

executable_checks.command: Compare on-chain hash with Nova circuit implementation
executable_checks.assertion: Hash computation identical to ZK circuit
Hash chain matches expected deterministic output

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-UPDATES-HASH-CHAIN. Hash chain consistency between on-chain contract and Nova circuit is critical. Any mismatch causes proof verification failure. SHA-256 collision resistance ensures chain integrity.

checklist.title: Verify IndexedTransfer event has strictly monotonic index
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate IndexedTransfer event definition
2. Verify index uses post-increment (index++)
3. Confirm no skips or duplicates in index sequence
4. Check index survives contract state (not memory-local)
5. Verify index is emitted atomically with transfer
6. Ensure index type has sufficient range

executable_checks.assertion: Each transfer has unique, sequential index

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT -> Edge EDGE-ZERC20-EMITS-EVENT. Index monotonicity is essential for Merkle tree construction. Post-increment pattern (index++) ensures sequential values without skips or duplicates.

checklist.title: Verify atomic transfer completion with no partial state
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify all transfer operations are in single transaction
2. Confirm no partial state possible on revert
3. Check balance update, hash chain update, and event are atomic
4. Verify no external calls that could fail after state changes
5. Ensure reentrancy guards if callbacks possible

executable_checks.assertion: All operations complete or all revert

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE -> Edge EDGE-TRANSFER-COMPLETE. EVM atomic transactions guarantee either all operations complete or all revert. No partial transfer state can persist.

checklist.title: Verify indexer monitors only authorized zERC20 contract addresses
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Review indexer configuration for contract address whitelist
2. Verify event filtering by contract address
3. Check no spoofed events can be indexed
4. Verify defense in depth: even spoofed events fail Merkle proof verification
5. Confirm indexer validates chain ID
6. Check for proper RPC endpoint authentication

executable_checks.command: Review indexer configuration and event filtering
executable_checks.assertion: Only authorized contract events are processed

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-INDEXER-WATCHES -> Edge EDGE-INDEXER-WATCHES. Even if spoofed events are indexed, Merkle proofs generated from them fail on-chain verification. Defense in depth protects against indexer compromise.

checklist.title: Verify indexer Merkle tree consistency with on-chain hash chain
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify Merkle tree construction matches on-chain hash algorithm
2. Confirm tree updates are applied in correct order
3. Check tree root can be verified against on-chain state
4. Verify no event reordering or missing events
5. Ensure tree survives indexer restarts
6. Check proof generation produces verifiable proofs

executable_checks.command: Compare indexer tree algorithm with on-chain hash chain

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-INDEXER-TREE-UPDATED -> Edge EDGE-INDEXER-TREE-UPDATED. Divergent trees produce invalid proofs that fail on-chain verification. Users can verify proofs against on-chain roots to detect indexer issues.

checklist.title: Verify indexer generates valid Merkle inclusion proofs
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Verify proof generation algorithm matches verification algorithm
2. Check proof includes all necessary siblings
3. Confirm proof direction bits are correct
4. Verify proof can be verified against known root
5. Test proof generation for various tree sizes
6. Ensure historical proofs remain valid

executable_checks.command: Test proof generation and verification round-trip

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-INDEXER-GENERATES-PROOF -> Edge EDGE-INDEXER-GENERATES-PROOF. Invalid proofs fail ZK circuit verification. Users can detect and report indexer issues. Merkle proof verification provides cryptographic guarantee.

checklist.title: Verify checkpoint creates immutable index-to-hashchain binding
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate reservedHashChains mapping in Verifier.sol
2. Verify no update function exists for existing checkpoints
3. Confirm only initial write path available
4. Check checkpoint cannot be overwritten
5. Verify checkpoint survives contract upgrade (if upgradeable)
6. Ensure checkpoint value cannot be zero (sentinel value)

executable_checks.assertion: Only single write path, no updates

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT -> Edge EDGE-VERIFIER-RESERVES-CHECKPOINT. Immutable checkpoints prevent attackers from changing the expected hash chain after proof generation begins. Only single write path ensures binding integrity.

checklist.title: Verify HashChainReserved event matches stored checkpoint data
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate HashChainReserved event definition
2. Verify event parameters match storage write values
3. Confirm event and storage use same transaction
4. Check event is emitted after successful storage
5. Verify no code paths emit event without storage
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-CHECKPOINT-RESERVED -> Edge EDGE-CHECKPOINT-RESERVED. Event-storage consistency ensures off-chain systems can accurately track checkpoints. Same values used in single transaction guarantees match.

checklist.title: Verify proof submission requires prior checkpoint reservation
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate proveTransferRoot() function
2. Verify check: reservedHashChains[index] != 0
3. Confirm missing checkpoint causes revert
4. Check proof cannot be submitted for arbitrary index
5. Verify checkpoint must match proof's claimed state
checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF -> Edge EDGE-AWAITING-NOVA-PROOF. Checkpoint prerequisite ensures provers commit to a specific state before proof generation. Prevents proof submission for non-reserved indices.

checklist.title: Verify transfer root storage only after successful Groth16 verification
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate proveTransferRoot() control flow
2. Verify verify() call returns before storage write
3. Confirm failed verify() causes revert (no storage)
4. Check no code paths store root without verification
5. Verify verification key is correct for circuit
6. Ensure public inputs match expected structure

executable_checks.command: Trace proveTransferRoot: verify() must precede storage
executable_checks.assertion: Control flow: verify returns before provedTransferRoots write
Invalid proof does not store root

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID -> Edge EDGE-NOVA-PROOF-VALID. Verification-before-storage ensures only valid proofs result in stored roots. Failed verify() reverts entire transaction. Groth16 provides cryptographic soundness guarantee.

checklist.title: Verify emergency trigger only on actual proof divergence (two valid different proofs)
checklist.detection_procedure:
1. Locate divergence detection logic in proveTransferRoot()
2. Verify check: provedTransferRoots[index] != 0 AND provedTransferRoots[index] != newRoot
3. Confirm both proofs must be valid for divergence
4. Check emergency is not triggered falsely
5. Verify first proof for index triggers no emergency
6. Ensure matching roots don't trigger emergency

executable_checks.assertion: Divergence detection and emergency trigger exist
Different valid proofs for same index trigger emergency
Same proof twice does not trigger emergency

checklist.notes: Traceability: Property PROP-EDGE-DIVERGENT-PROOF-DETECTED -> Edge EDGE-DIVERGENT-PROOF-DETECTED. Divergence detection requires two independent valid proofs producing different roots. This indicates a soundness breach in the ZK system and triggers emergency mode for investigation.
